body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: f858a649c7243570a5ebe8b0d8aa7d5e9c2b9b05 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The change blocks machine edits that could permit turning output on a mill.

What looks good:

- The refusal occurs before command creation. It names `kind`, the mounted machine, and the required action.
- The regression checks document and setup machines, kind aliases, unchanged state, and the undo history.
- An existing lathe still accepts edits through the existing undoable command.
- The decision file explains the conservative refusal and the alternative that was rejected.

Results ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2650`, after a clean trial merge with upstream main `05f7f06f65f15d69116d99c23c0e23532a5749ac`.
The gate plan selected the app unit tests and `mcp_edit_machine`. No GitHub runner was used.
The commands used a separate target directory and disabled the inherited optional sccache wrapper.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_edit_machine --no-run -j 6` | Passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib -j 6` | 379 passed; 1 existing heavy test ignored |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_edit_machine -j 6` | 6 passed; repeated after source restoration |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -j 6 -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| `git diff --check` | Passed |

I ran two temporary mutations in the review worktree:

1. I removed the new guard to restore upstream behavior. `kind_edit_cannot_relabel_a_mill_for_turning` failed because the mill accepted `kind: lathe`.
2. I removed the exemption for existing turning machines. `an_existing_lathe_keeps_its_machine_edits` failed because a valid lathe edit was refused.

The PR documents the first mutation. I added the second check for this review.
Both mutations failed the expected test with exit code 101. I restored the exact source, then all six tests passed again.
No mutation was committed or pushed.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes:

- No NC or CL golden changed. The corresponding diff is empty.
- No UI file changed. Before and after screenshots are not required.
- No process file, dependency, build script, or workflow changed.
- The laws were checked against upstream main's current `AGENTS.md`.
- No physical machine test or full release gate was run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merge class: SAME. The head `f858a649c7243570a5ebe8b0d8aa7d5e9c2b9b05` is the reviewed head, and no commit came after the review. The PR merges cleanly with `main` without a refresh.

This merge relies on the collaborator review of this head by mkinney (`pr-reviewer` marker) and on the `merge-ready` label that he set. The PR fixes a P3 issue, so it needs no second review.
